_note: Hand-authored run control file. Gate 2 (scope gate) reads this to confirm a run declares its mode before ingest begins. Not generated by any script; edit it deliberately.
frozen_clock_basis: fixture-manifest.json frozen_at. The ONLY clock any step may read for content. Freshness windows are measured from it and it keeps runs byte-reproducible; steps must not call now() for anything that lands in an artifact.

live_mode_requirements.credential_policy: Environment variables only; never hardcoded, never stored in this file.

overrides.fixture_set: Pass --fixture-set clean|defective to override for one run. The run directory is named per fixture set so runs never collide.
